# ActaSeal

> Policy gateway in front of money-touching agent actions: a policy decision, evidence check, tamper-evident ledger and a signed receipt for every action, with human approval where the policy asks for it. Self-hosted. Receipts are checked offline with an open-source verifier.

## Check a receipt

- https://verify.actaseal.com : the offline verifier, in the browser or as a download
- https://pypi.org/project/actaseal-verify/ : `pip install actaseal-verify` (Apache License 2.0)
- https://github.com/actaseal/actaseal-verify : source and conformance vectors

## Read

- https://actaseal.com/docs/ : quickstart and SDK usage
- https://actaseal.com/limits/ : what ActaSeal is not
- https://actaseal.com/trust/ : trust page
- https://actaseal.com/security/ : reporting a vulnerability
- https://actaseal.com/notes/ : notes
